description: Digest mirror of the owner decisions that govern this project. The records themselves live in the workspace orchestrator's immutable protected store and are deliberately NOT committed: this repository is public and those records carry internal deliberation, cost figures and infrastructure identifiers. Committing their sha256 gets tamper-detection without the disclosure. sha256.description: Bare hex sha256 of the protected-store file, matching how the ledger records quote it.

cited_by_sequences.description: Ledger sequences whose hashed rationales assert this digest. Empty means no divergence record cites it and the decision is mirrored because the gate design itself rests on it.
